description: This file contains utility functions for end-to-end testing in the Notesnook project, including dialog interactions, list iteration, and UI element manipulation.

methods.name: iterateList
methods.description: Asynchronously iterates over a list of Locator elements.

methods.name: fillNotebookDialog
methods.description: Fills in the notebook dialog with provided Notebook data.

methods.name: fillReminderDialog
methods.description: Fills in the reminder dialog with provided Reminder data.

methods.name: fillItemDialog
methods.description: Fills in the item dialog with provided Item data.

methods.name: fillColorDialog
methods.description: Fills in the color dialog with provided Color data.

methods.name: fillPasswordDialog
methods.description: Fills in the password dialog with a given password.

methods.name: fillConfirmPasswordDialog
methods.description: Fills in the password and confirm password fields.

methods.name: confirmDialog
methods.description: Confirms a dialog by clicking the 'yes' button.

methods.name: denyDialog
methods.description: Deny or cancel a dialog by clicking the 'no' button.

methods.name: waitForDialog
methods.description: Waits for a dialog with a specific title to appear and then disappear.

methods.name: waitToHaveText
methods.description: Waits until a specific element contains text.
